name: Cardiff 5K
notes: Chip time 17:48, gun 17:53. New fastest 5K of 2026 (PB by 1m2s vs previous 2026 time). 104th of 400 overall, 12th of 48 in M45 age group (top 50). 24-25C. Bang on plan through 3km, started to fade around 4.5km - stone in shoe caused a blister but nothing major. Nike Vaporfly.

name: Cheltenham Half Marathon
notes: Target 1:22:00, band 1:21-1:23. 13C, ~12mph westerly, cloudy. Executed to the written splits: 5km 19:09, 10km 38:34, 15km 57:53, 20km 1:17:33, ahead of plan at every checkpoint and never gave it back. First 10km 38:34, second 10km 38:58 - a 24 second positive split. Km 20 (the climb) 4:10.9; km 21 3:38.3, the fastest of the race. Avg HR 164, max 174, RPE 8, achilles 0. 17 seconds off his lifetime half PB of 1:20:47, at 50.
